[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
if a % 10 = 0 ∨ b % 10 = 0 then 0
else
  let unit_a := a % 10
  let unit_b := b % 10
  let product := unit_a * unit_b
  if product < 0 then product + 100 else product
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma mod10_nonzero_mul_nonzero
(a b: Int)
(ha: a % 10 ≠ 0)
(hb: b % 10 ≠ 0)
: (a * b) % 10 = (a % 10 * b % 10) % 10 :=
by
have h_product_nonneg := by
  linarith
have h_product_nonneg': 0 ≤ a * b := by
  linarith
have h_unit_nonneg: 0 ≤ a % 10 := by
  linarith
have h_unit_nonneg': 0 ≤ b % 10 := by
  linarith
have h_unit_pos: 0 < a % 10 := by
  linarith
have h_unit_pos': 0 < b % 10 := by
  linarith
have h_unit_product_pos: 0 < a % 10 * b % 10 := by
  linarith
have h_unit_product_nonneg: 0 ≤ a % 10 * b % 10 := by
  linarith
have h_unit_product_nonneg': 0 ≤ (a % 10 * b % 10) % 10 := by
  linarith
have h_unit_product_pos': 0 < (a % 10 * b % 10) % 10 := by
  linarith
have h_unit_product_mod: a % 10 * b % 10 % 10 = (a % 10 * b % 10) % 10 := by
  linarith
have h_product_mod: (a * b) % 10 = (a * b) % 10 := by
  linarith
have h_unit_product_mod': (a % 10 * b % 10) % 10 = (a % 10 * b % 10) % 10 := by
  linarith
show (a * b) % 10 = (a % 10 * b % 10) % 10
by
  rw [h_product_mod, h_unit_product_mod']
